source: segmentation (Blender simulation with background replaced by white)
time_convention: t = frame / 120; frame = round(t * 120); t=0 is frame 0
pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left, pixel centres at integer coordinates

camera.motion: static (static truck regions differ < 3 grey levels between frame 0 and 199; truck edges identical to 1 px)
camera.view: straight-on view of the rear of a box truck; the box falls in the image plane. Mild perspective: the box's underside is visible while it is high in the frame (up to ~34 px tall at frame 0, vanishing as it reaches the roof), so the camera is roughly at truck-roof height (~y 525-535). Box width stays 280.5 +- 0.5 px during the fall -> the box moves at constant depth (planar motion).

objects.name: box
objects.description: brown cardboard box with one dark open flap sticking up at its top right; the only object above the truck
objects.reference_point: centre of the front face: cx = (left_x+right_x)/2, cy = front_top_y + 205.3/2

size_px.front_face_height_note: measured at rest (frames 74-199, no underside visible); while falling the visible height includes the greyish underside (236.5 px total at frame 0)

objects.name: tail_lift_platform
objects.description: dark (near-black, mottled) tail-lift / loading platform at the bottom of the rear door opening; lies flat (seen nearly edge-on as a thin dark strip at y~1020-1028) then folds up about its bottom hinge (y~1028) to close against the door
objects.reference_point: top (free) edge y = top_y (sub-pixel); hinge line y = 1028; cx,cy = centre of its visible projection

size_px.top_edge_width: 249 when near-vertical, up to ~280 when tilted ~45 deg (free edge nearer the camera); occasional larger values 290-330 at frames 72-78 are the side arm/shadow merging
size_px.note: still rotating at frame 199, so 220.6 px is a lower bound on the platform depth (hinge-to-free-edge length)

objects.name: truck_rear_body
objects.description: white rear of a box truck (cargo box) with yellow outline stripe, centred bottom of frame

objects.name: rear_door_opening
objects.description: grey roller door in a dark frame in the middle of the truck rear

objects.name: yellow_outline_stripe
objects.description: yellow reflective stripe framing the truck rear

objects.name: red_white_chevron_panels
objects.description: two vertical red/white (yellow) warning-chevron panels at the lower left and lower right corners

objects.name: red_lamp_handle
objects.description: small red lamp/handle left of the door, x 796-815, y 928-967 (20 x 40 px); partly hidden behind the platform's left side arm after ~frame 150

objects.name: doll_plates
objects.description: yellow 'DOLL' text plates at the bottom left (x~735-800) and bottom right (x~1070-1150), y ~983-1003

objects.name: top_light
objects.description: small grey light/bracket at the top centre of the truck rear, x ~905-955, y ~545-585

objects.name: under_truck_shadow_chassis
objects.description: dark chassis/shadow below the truck, y ~1046-1080, x ~710-1190; a light grey bumper bar at y ~1048-1055 between x ~805-1085 appears once the platform lifts

events.event: box release / start of fall (first displacement at frame 5)
box first contact with truck roof
events.note: front_top 315.4 at frames 60-61, 320.4 at frame 62 (lowest/compressed), so impact between frames 60 and 62

events.event: box small rebound peak (~2 px up)
box settled at rest on roof
platform starts to tilt (edge-on strip widens)
platform still rising (decelerating) at end of clip
